newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV to open Colombian office.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV to open Colombian office.

text.p: CARTAGENA, Colombia, May 8 Reuter - Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV plans to launch corporate banking operations in Colombia early next year, a spokesman for the Amsterdam-based banking giant said.

Robert Rekkers, ABN Amro's general manager for Colombia, said authorities were expected to license the bank to operate locally by September and that a branch office would open in Bogota by the start of 1998.
Initial investment in the Colombian operation would come in at about 28 billion pesos, Rekkers told Reuters on the sidelines of a Colombian Banking Association meeting in this colonial port.
"The idea is to begin as a corporate bank, a local bank, with a minimum capital of 28 billion pesos," Rekkers said.
He said ABN AMRO, which already operates in every Latin American country with the exception of Colombia and Peru, is Europe's fifth largest bank. (-- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944)
